title: 3D Quality Check
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor #### Compatibility: Supported for 3D files. Find the detailed file format list here. # # **Updates** 3D Quality Check allows you to check the properties of the CLO file in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776274210073) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271643417) ---|--- 1. What it Quality Check? 2. Setup Quality Check 3. Quality Check in Content Page 4. Quality Check Results 5. Supported File Formats 6. Setup Guide PDF (ENG) # **Details** ### 1) What is 3D Quality Check? * CLO-SET Quality check allows teams to automize the QC process of the CLO files. CLO-SET will automatically check the uploaded CLO file properties per the standards setup by the Admin and mark the result for the team to view. * Quality Check standards can be set for each Company within the Group. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271792665) ### 2) Setup Quality Check **Permission** : ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873) Group Admin, Company Admin * To start using the feature, your Company must have a 3D Quality Check standards setup by the Admin. This can be done on the [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/articles/45303214894873) page. * In Company Settings, click Content > 3D Quality Check. Then, click the activate toggle. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776272087961) * For more details on how to input the properties and what each property refers to in CLO, please[ download the PDF guideline.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49715354278809) [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776275644441)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) | [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776283678233)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) ---|--- * **Please note** : updating the properties will NOT be synced to older tests. You must re-upload the file to apply the new standards. ### 3) Quality Check in Content Page Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776274210073) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271643417) ---|--- * Once the Quality Check is activated and setup, it will be applied to the newly uploaded files. * Click the red 'QC' icon next to the version name to view the full test result. * **Please Note** : Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. * The 'QC' label will be displayed on the latest version uploaded. To review the QC for older versions, click the ••• menu and select '3D Quality Check' option as displayed below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776324372377) ### ### 4) Quality Check Results Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor * A new tab will open with the full test result. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776292991001) * 1. 1. Category of the property 2. Property setup in Company Settings 3. Criteria setup in Company Settings 4. Test result: Passed 5. Test result: Failed, click the list icon for the list of materials that failed the test 6. Test result: N/A. Property not included in the checklist 7. Select to only view the properties that failed the test * * **Please note** : Updating or editing the 3D file should be done in CLO. Also, Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. ### 5) Supported File Formats * Compatible with all file types supported in 3D Viewer, as of Dec 2024. * More specifically, 3D Quality Check is compatible with the file extensions listed below: * zpac, zprj, avt, obj, fbx, dae, glb, grp, zfab, zmod, trm, btn, bth, zpl, zsd, zse, zsp, zpu, zsl, zst, zss, sst, zacs, pos, hpos
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on setting up and utilizing the 3D Quality Check feature in CLO-SET, enabling teams to automate the quality control process for CLO files based on customizable standards.

title: 3D Viewer
content: # **Objective** 1. Icons & Features 2. View Control * Mac Navigation 3. CLO-SET 3D Viewer Rendering Policy # **Details** ### 1) Icons & Features ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988794413081) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988810563225) ---|--- If the icon is crossed out, it means there is no data within your content. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988794415001) ### 2) View Control (Mouse Navigation) **Mouse / Keyboard** | | **3D Viewer** ---|---|--- Roll up/down the Cursor | **![Scroll.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778161335833)**| Zoom in / Zoom out Hold down the cursor wheel and drag | ![Mouse \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778132646297) | Pan 3D View Hold down the right click and drag | ![right click and rotate.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778132776857) | Rotate 3D View Number keys | 🔢 | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778161829401) * #### **Mac Navigation** For details on Mac Navigation, please find the[ attached PDF file](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778133177625). ### 3) CLO-SET 3D Viewer Rendering Policy CLO-SET is designed to provide a 3D viewing experience that closely matches **CLO** , allowing users to seamlessly review and share 3D assets online. However, since the CLO-SET 3D Viewer operates in a web environment, some rendering specifications available in CLO may not be fully supported. To improve transparency and layer accuracy, the 3D Viewer includes **Depth Peeling** , which helps maintain proper layer separation and realistic depth when displaying garments. You can control this feature using the **Quality Render** option in the toolbar: **Toolbar: Quality Render ON/OFF** * **ON (Default):** Depth Peeling enabled * **OFF:** Depth Peeling disabled ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54987611635737) **[Exceptions]** Depth Peeling is **not applied** in the following cases: * When displaying thumbnails in the Workroom → Thumbnails may appear slightly translucent in the Workroom preview. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52158899977113)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to the icons, features, and navigation controls of the CLO-SET 3D Viewer, along with its rendering policies to enhance the user experience in reviewing and sharing 3D assets.

title: Terms & Interface
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 New to CLO-SET? We've got you. Scroll to learn the terms & tricks before diving in to CLO-SET. * Terms * Dashboard * Content Page (3D / 2D Viewer) * Tree Menu # **📓 Details** **•Terms** --- **▶** Group (![group.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776252644761))**:** Highest space level in CLO-SET. Each user owns 1 Group (ex. A's Group) **▶** Workroom (![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776220467097))**:** Where you upload your files. Consider this a 'folder' **▶** Content (![content.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776235598105))**:** Created whenever you upload a new file. You may upload any file format (not just 3D files) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269142169) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776253480985) ---|--- **• Dashboard** --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54868579650841) * **Menu Pane****:** Navigate between spaces, manage settings, and search Contents. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269728281) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269920409) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776221571097) ---|---|--- * **Contents List** : Easily spot the recents Contents visited, or those with latest updated. (recent content / updated content) * **Workrooms List** : Your go-to Workrooms listed. (favorite workroom / all workroom) * **Profile & Notification**: Manage account settings and notifications. _**💡 Notes**_ > Notification Tabs : **All, Comments, Updates, Account & Billing**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54189220286489)**Notification Types**
> > **1\. Comments** : user comments and annotations
> > \- comment, commnet_delete, annotation, annotation_delete, CONNECT marketplace_feedback, CONNECT marketplace_request.
> > **2\. Updates** : work and content-related updates
> > \- upload, render, fitting convert, configurator, web techpack, visual board, move, copy, delete, workroom, state, score, share
> > **3\. Account & Billing**: account, access, and billing notices
> > \- member, news, card, connect_purchase **• Content Page (3D / 2D Viewer)** --- In the left menu pane, follow these steps: 1. Click the **Browse** icon. 2. Select **Company** at the top of the menu tree. 3. Double-click **Brand** in the main screen. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870706690585) 4. Double-click the **Season** in the Brand space.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870708691993) 5. Double-click the **Workroom** in the Season space.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870706694425) 6. Double-click the **Content** in the Workroom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870706696089) You will be taken to the **Content page** , where you can view the detailed information of the content. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54870708700057) **• Tree Menu** --- CLO-SET provides a pre-made space structure for easier asset management. * In each Group, there is Company ▶ Brand ▶ Line ▶ Season ▶ Workroom / Assortment ▶ Content * **Workroom**(![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776220467097)) is where you can upload your Contents * Click 'Browse' at the left to expand the tree menu to find the space you're looking for ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776269142169) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55000901644569) ---|---
content_description: Welcome to CLO-SET: Your go-to guide for mastering essential terms and tools for a seamless experience in our platform.

title: Copy Space Structure
content: #### **Permission** : may vary per scenario. Please see below. # **Objective** With this feature, you can easily replicate the Space Structure to prepare for a new season. 1. Copy Space Structure 2. Copy Company 3. Copy Brand 4. Copy Line/Season 5. Additional Notes # **Details** ### 1) Copy Space Structure * Simply copy any Space from Company to Season along with sub-level Spaces up to the 1st-depth Workroom. * Only the Space Hierarchy will be copied, **NOT** including the Contents within the original Space. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.09.29 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778491077529) * **Basics:** * Go to 'Browse' menu or 'Workspace' to find the Space you want to Copy * On the upper-right corner of the Space, click ••• then click 'Copy Space Structure' * Insert the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * **Only the Space Structure will be copied** without Contents, Categories, and Workflows ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.31 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778475909017) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55008522309145) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476467737) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.41 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492075033) ### 2) Copy Company Structure **Permission** : Group Admin only * Go to Workspace > Companies to select the Company to Copy * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Company > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Company Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu * The new Company Space will replicate all Company Settings of the original Company. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.42.51 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778477146521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.25.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476219673) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.45.52 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492822681) ---|---|--- ### 3) Copy Brand Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Company within which the Brand is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Brands * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Brand > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Brand, and select where you want the new Brand to be * You may only choose between Company Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Brand Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492992537) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.52.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778478042521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.53.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493487513) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.24 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493748505) ### ### 4) Copy Line/Season Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin, Company Collaborator, Brand Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Brand within which the Line/Season is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Lines/Seasons * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Line/Season > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and select where you want the new Line/Season to be * You may only choose between Brand Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 8.05.27 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778478952601) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55010152983193) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.53.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493487513) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 8.04.12 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778494800921) ### 5) Additional Notes Please mind that the Copy Space Structure: * only copies the Space Hierarchy, **NOT** the Contents within * copying the Space between Groups is unavailable * copying Workroom/Assortment level Spaces is unavailable * Space creation or duplication may be limited depending on your plan. If you reach the limit, an “Upgrade Your Plan” pop-up will appear as shown below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55008522319513)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to replicate Space Structures for companies, brands, and seasons, including step-by-step instructions and permissions required for each action.

title: Strain Map on 3D Viewer
content: Compatible with Contents uploaded post **December 6th, 2023** # **Objectives** With this update, you can view the garment Strain map as done in CLO3D. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55009655280281) 1. Strain Map in Content Page * Compatibility 2. What is Strain Map? # **Details** ### 1) Strain Map in Content Page In the Content Page, click the 'Strain Map' icon, or use shortcut key (Shift + 7) Once Strain Map is activated, you can find the Tightness Range bar on the top right. #### **[Strain Map Compatibility]** * Content must have been uploaded after **December 6th, 2023**. If you see below error message, please re-upload the file to view Strain Map. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307250457) * Strain Map is only applied to garments, not avatars. * Strain Map is **NOT** compatible with: * Garment Rendering Style Group * Schematic Render * Render * Configurator * Filter ### 2) What is Strain Map? ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307394329) Strain Map displays the distortion rate from 2D patterns to 3D patterns. This view is the same as CLO3D's ['Strain Map'](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/articles/115012227287-Strain-Map) view in 'Monochrome' mode. * (3D pattern size / 2D Pattern size * 100)% Blue: 100% distortion, which means no distortion keeping the original pattern stretch Red: 120% distortion. The higher the rate is, the more distortion there are between 2D & 3D patterns. You may adjust the pattern placement/size based on the Strain Map data.
content_description: Explore the new Strain Map feature for garments uploaded after December 6th, 2023, to visualize distortion rates between 2D and 3D patterns and enhance your design adjustments.

title: Content Information Fields
content: # **Objective** Learn about Content Information Fields in CLO-SET and how to effectively utilize the feature. 1. What is Content Information Field? 2. Field Management * Default Fields * Custom Fields * *Number Type Fields 3. Input/View Content Information 4. Permission # # **Detail** ### **1) What is Content Information Field?** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55009085377561) * The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. * Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. ### ### 2) Field Management **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778881725081) * Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). * To add/edit Content Fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), visit [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873). * Click on 'Content' > 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. * Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). #### **1\. Default Fields** * Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. * CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. * For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. * To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. * ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778943746585) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778912589465) ---|--- #### **2\. Custom Fields** * Custom Fields are fully customizable. Can create up to 16 Custom Fields per Content Type. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778912761113) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778904421913) ---|--- * To add a Custom Field, start by clicking the 'Add Custom Field' button. * Fill in the name and select the 'Type' of the field to be used. Fill in values or unit information when applicable, and click 'Save' to create the Custom Field. * Field Types provided are listed below. Once the field is saved, field type **CANNOT** be changed. * Text (up to 100 characters) * Textbox (up to 1000 characters) * Number (in unit format) * Date (in calendar format) * Dropdown: single-selection * Checkbox: multi-selection allowed * To **edit** the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. Changing the field details will impact the existing field information. * To **delete** the Custom Field, hover over the field row and click the trash button. Deleting the field will impact the existing field information, and the data stored will no longer be available. #### **3\. 'Number' Type Fields** **Unit Options** | **Currency Options for Price** | **Unit Format Example** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778913205657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778904807833) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778916815001) * When editing the 'Number' type fields, you have an option to customize the unit format. * Please refer to the table below for placeholders used to customize the unit format. **Placeholder** | **Explanation** ---|--- 0 | The number of digits. Insignificant zeros are displayed in the result # | The number of digits. Meaningless zeros will not appear in the result . (decimal point) | Format numbers with decimal separators , (rest) | Specifies a thousands separator in a number ### 3) Input/View Content Information **Permission** : All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit field information / Viewers are read only ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55009085377561) * Go to Content Page, and click the 'More Information' button on the left pane. * Once the Content Field Management section is open on the right pane, click on the field to begin entering the information. * Any information added or edited will be saved immediately as entered. Exiting the Content Field tab will NOT undo the changes. ### ### 4) Permission * Field Management: by Group Admin or Company Admin at Company Settings page * Input/View Content Information: All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit field information. Viewers are read only
content_description: Discover how to effectively utilize Content Information Fields in CLO-SET to enhance your asset management through customizable field management and streamlined content input.

title: What is CLO-SET? (eCLOsystem)
content: [![CLO-SET Profile White.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776117198745)](https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus) CLO-SET is a Collaborative 3D Creation Workspace that maximizes the value of the 3D assets by bridging stages of the product life cycle in one centralized digital space. #### ### 1) Create/Prepare 3D Design Start off your CLO Virtual Fashion journey by creating your own design. Start creating your own design on the software, or download sample files from CONNECT marketplace. * Create your own 3D Design in [CLO](https://clo3d.com) or [Marvelous Designer](https://marvelousdesigner.com) software. * Prepare sample 3D files from [CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) mraketplace. ![BI_CLO_Blue.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776148489625) | ![3. Signature logo_Vertical_Shade\(Primary\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776100896409) | ![CONNECT BI Primary.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776149025689) ---|---|--- ### 2) Upload & Explore CLO-SET Once you have the 3D files ready, start uploading your files in [CLO-SET](https://style.clo-set.com). * ### Check out **Solutions** that meets your needs. For: * [Brands](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-brands) * [Manufacturers](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-manufacturers) * [Individuals](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-individuals) * ### Check out CLO-SET **Key Features** : * [3D Workspace](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#3d-workspace) * [3D Web Tech Pack](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#3d-web-tech-pack) * [Collaboration](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#collaboration) * [Cloud Rendering](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#cloud-rendering) * [Developer Tools](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#developer-tools) * [Retail & Commercial](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#retail-commercial) ### 3) Start using CLO-SET * #### [CLO-SET FAQ](https://style.clo-set.com/service/contactus) * #### [Creating an Account](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190161177) * #### [CLO-SET Pricing Plan](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) * [Start by learning how to upload files](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303166737305-Upload-Download) _**💡 Notes**_ > **CLO software** is used to design and create garments in 3D, while **CONNECT** is the marketplace for buying and selling avatars, garments, and digital assets. > **CLO-SET** then brings these assets together into a collaborative workspace for managing, reviewing, sharing, and seamlessly carrying them through merchandising and production. ####
content_description: CLO-SET is a centralized digital workspace that enhances the value of 3D assets by streamlining collaboration across all stages of the product life cycle in the fashion industry.
